name: Hardtail
line: A suspension fork, a rigid back end: light, simple and the easiest to look after.
terrain: Pass roads, gravel and your first trails

name: Cross-country
line: Light carbon bikes with short travel, built to climb fast and race.
terrain: Long climbs, fast singletrack, race days

name: Trail
line: Suspension front and back for rock, roots and steep ground.
terrain: Rough trails, broken roads, steep descents

name: E-MTB
line: A motor that adds to your pedalling, for longer days and steeper climbs.
terrain: Big days, high passes, the climbs you used to walk
